name: CIFAR10-DVS
description: An event-stream object-classification dataset created by converting 10,000 CIFAR-10 images into event streams with a dynamic vision sensor; it covers 10 object classes.
citation: Li, H., Liu, H., Ji, X., Li, G., & Shi, L. (2017). CIFAR10-DVS: An Event-Stream Dataset for Object Classification. Frontiers in Neuroscience, 11, 309. https://doi.org/10.3389/fnins.2017.00309
